## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behaviour to change)
- [ ] Translation (English strings or fixes; other languages go through AMOS)
- [ ] Docs / chore / CI

## Moodle versions tested

- [ ] 4.5
- [ ] 5.2
- [ ] 5.3

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the [Moodle coding style](https://moodledev.io/general/development/policies/codingstyle).
- [ ] New identifiers, comments and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] Lang strings (if added) are alphabetically sorted in `lang/en/` and `lang/es/`.
- [ ] Anything new stored about users is covered by the privacy provider.
- [ ] `version.php` bumped and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change reaches users.
